author: blu
body: listen and is-quiet were declared as operations of the Microphone effect in Foreword chapter Microphone with no handler, so a call died at emit with CDX2040. They are real here, over the HDA input stream codex-vm now captures the host microphone into (Kernel chapter HdaAudio's hda-capture pulls the most recent samples from stream 1). They are not in the foreword because reading the mic is MMIO and MMIO is codex.os; a chapter that wants them cites this one.

author: blu
body: What "loudness" the host delivers depends on the host's default recording device and its level, and on the OS granting the process microphone access; codex-vm captures whatever that device provides.
